# Personal Hub

> A calm, local-first toolkit for projects, daily logs, content ideas, and job search tracking.

Personal Hub is an installable PWA that stores user data in the browser with IndexedDB (via Dexie). It has no required account, backend sync, or analytics pipeline for user content.

## Site

- Production URL: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com
- Source: https://github.com/lakshay2425/personal-hub
- Sitemap: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com/robots.txt
- Data reference (schemas, exports): https://github.com/lakshay2425/personal-hub/blob/master/DATA.md

## Public Routes

These are crawlable app shell / marketing pages. Dynamic IDs in URLs (e.g. project or company detail) contain no server-hosted user data.

- `/` — Landing page overview
- `/projects` — Project list and question inbox
- `/projects/[projectId]` — Project detail (Questions + Content Ideas tabs)
- `/content-ideas` — Standalone content ideas
- `/logger` — Daily log entries
- `/logger/dashboard` — Date-filtered log review
- `/job-search` — Dashboard (stats, activity, follow-ups)
- `/job-search/companies` — Company list
- `/job-search/companies/[id]` — Company detail
- `/job-search/leads` — Leads
- `/job-search/applications` — Applications
- `/job-search/cold-emails` — Cold emails

Legacy redirect: `/questions` → `/projects`.

## Tools & Capabilities

### Projects
- Question inbox and project organization with titled answers
- Sub-question hierarchy (max depth 2: root → sub → sub-sub)
- Drag-and-drop reorder among siblings; move questions between projects/inbox
- JSON export/import (full overwrite)

### Content Ideas
- Standalone (`/content-ideas`) or per-project (tab in project detail)
- Sub-idea hierarchy (max depth 2), drag-and-drop, reparent via overflow menu
- Status: Draft / Ready / Published; published links (LinkedIn, Twitter, blog, other)
- View modes: table, cards, list (persisted in localStorage)
- Activity log for lifecycle events
- Included in Projects JSON export (not a separate export)

### Logger
- Multiple timestamped entries per calendar day
- Dashboard view to filter entries by date
- JSON export/import

### Job Search
- Companies, leads, applications, cold emails
- Dashboard with time filters (today, 7/30/90 days, all time)
- Global search across entities
- Company detail pages; creatable selects for sector/role/type
- Lead channel: Email, LinkedIn, X, Other — follow-up dates shown for Email leads only
- Voice-to-text input on forms (Web Speech API)
- Activity logs per entity type
- JSON export/import (version 2)

## Data Storage

Three separate IndexedDB databases (Dexie):

| Database | Dexie name | Feature |
|----------|------------|---------|
| Projects & Content Ideas | `question-hub-db` | Projects, questions, answers, content ideas |
| Logger | `logger-db` | Daily log entries |
| Job Search | `job-search-tracker-db` | Companies, leads, applications, cold emails |

All user content stays on the device. Export/import is manual JSON backup — there is no cloud sync.

For full schemas, migration history, and export JSON shapes, see DATA.md in the repository.

## PWA

- Installable via web app manifest (`display: standalone`)
- Service worker (Serwist) caches app shell and visited routes for offline use
- IndexedDB read/write works offline once the JS shell is cached
- Uncached offline navigations fall back to `/~offline`

## Tech Stack

Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Dexie, Zod, react-hook-form, @dnd-kit, Serwist, react-hot-toast.

## Notes For Assistants

- Treat all user-created app data as local browser data, not server-hosted public content.
- Do not infer public project, company, lead, application, or log records from dynamic routes — those pages render empty shells until the user loads their local IndexedDB data.
- Prefer the sitemap for crawlable public pages.
- When answering schema or export-format questions, refer to DATA.md rather than guessing field names.
